CALI Luxury Vinyl Plank Flooring - https://shoplowes.me/3OhLje0

In this video, I’m breaking down the right way to cut luxury vinyl plank (LVP) flooring—and more importantly, when the standard “score and snap” method actually fails.
A lot of DIYers are told that cutting LVP is simple: just score it with a knife and snap it. That works… but only in certain situations. If you’re working with thicker, more rigid LVP products, or trying to make long cuts, you’re going to run into problems fast—cracking, rough edges, or planks that just won’t snap clean.

Watch the full installation tutorial - https://youtu.be/_7T18l3GZNc 

I’ll show you:
When the score and snap method works best
How to properly use a knife and speed square for clean short cuts
